name: wai
description: The wAI skill suite's own marketplace: one plugin, thirteen skills for sustainable software product development — maintainable, clean architecture and first-class security — with a merge decision that belongs to a script's exit code and a human, not to the model.

plugins.name: wai-suite
plugins.description: The wAI gated-lifecycle suite for sustainable software engineering: 13 skills (router, init, planning, implementation, testing, PR review with a mechanical merge gate, architecture & security audits, an artifact-derived retrospective, CI/CD and mobile-release setup, team orchestrator, personal learning mode) that keep architecture maintainable and security audited while agents build. Evidence-first: every enforcement claim in the repo has a check behind it.
